mechanism_narrative: INSR-IL6ST forced proximity via flexible_GS8 linker creates a biased signaling output dominated by STAT3 transphosphorylation (INSR kinase directly phosphorylating STAT3 on IL6ST-bound JAK-scaffolded sites) and enhanced IRS-PI3K-AKT signaling (dual input from INSR kinase and JAK2). The MAPK-ERK arm is moderately activated via SHC1-GRB2-SOS and PTPN11. SOCS3 negative feedback and CBL-mediated degradation are partially sterically excluded by the co-clustered geometry. The net transcriptional outcome shifts aged muscle toward a young phenotype: upregulation of SRF-dependent muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) and AKT-dependent survival genes, with suppression of aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory markers (IL32, TXNIP).
